app_setting_days_chk.name: app_setting_days_chk
app_setting_days_chk.value: "app"."app_setting"."offer_validity_days" > 0 AND "app"."app_setting"."routing_rejection_cooldown_days" >= 0 AND "app"."app_setting"."sourcing_ownership_window_days" > 0 AND ("app"."app_setting"."retention_rejected_months" IS NULL OR "app"."app_setting"."retention_rejected_months" > 0)

app_user_deactivated_by_chk.name: app_user_deactivated_by_chk
app_user_deactivated_by_chk.value: "app"."app_user"."deactivated_by" IS NULL OR "app"."app_user"."deactivated_at" IS NOT NULL

file_object_size_chk.name: file_object_size_chk
file_object_size_chk.value: "app"."file_object"."size_bytes" > 0 AND "app"."file_object"."size_bytes" <= CASE "app"."file_object"."bucket" WHEN 'polygraph' THEN 15728640 WHEN 'offer' THEN 5242880 WHEN 'cv' THEN 10485760 WHEN 'attachment' THEN 10485760 ELSE 0 END

file_object_mime_chk.name: file_object_mime_chk
file_object_mime_chk.value: ("app"."file_object"."bucket" IN ('polygraph','offer') AND "app"."file_object"."mime_type" = 'application/pdf') OR ("app"."file_object"."bucket" IN ('cv','attachment') AND "app"."file_object"."mime_type" IN ('application/pdf','application/msword','application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document')) OR ("app"."file_object"."bucket" = 'attachment' AND "app"."file_object"."mime_type" IN ('image/png','image/jpeg'))

file_object_status_chk.name: file_object_status_chk
file_object_status_chk.value: "app"."file_object"."status" IN ('PENDING','READY','REJECTED','PURGED') AND ("app"."file_object"."status" <> 'READY' OR "app"."file_object"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("app"."file_object"."status" <> 'PURGED' OR ("app"."file_object"."original_filename" IS NULL AND "app"."file_object"."sha256" IS NULL AND "app"."file_object"."etag" IS NULL AND "app"."file_object"."purged_at" IS NOT NULL))

file_object_owner_chk.name: file_object_owner_chk
file_object_owner_chk.value: "app"."file_object"."owner_type" IN ('candidate','polygraph','offer') AND ("app"."file_object"."bucket" = 'offer' OR "app"."file_object"."uploaded_by" IS NOT NULL)

user_invite_status_chk.name: user_invite_status_chk
user_invite_status_chk.value: ("app"."user_invite"."status" = 'PENDING' AND "app"."user_invite"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "app"."user_invite"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "app"."user_invite"."revoked_by" IS NULL) OR ("app"."user_invite"."status" = 'ACCEPTED' AND "app"."user_invite"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."user_invite"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "app"."user_invite"."revoked_by" IS NULL) OR ("app"."user_invite"."status" = 'REVOKED' AND "app"."user_invite"."accepted_at" IS NULL AND "app"."user_invite"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."user_invite"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL)

user_role_scope_chk.name: user_role_scope_chk
user_role_scope_chk.value: ("app"."user_role"."role" IN ('ADMIN','FINANCE') AND "app"."user_role"."vertical_id" IS NULL) OR ("app"."user_role"."role" IN ('HEAD_RECRUITER','RECRUITER','HEAD_HR','HR','TEAM_LEAD') AND "app"."user_role"."vertical_id" IS NOT NULL) OR "app"."user_role"."role" ~ '^custom:[a-z0-9_]+$'
